Hi Lucy — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we don’t lose momentum:

Summary of what we covered:
- Goal: Surface accurate product recommendations in Streamline’s customer portal with 99th percentile latency under 250ms for interactive flows.
- Dataset: You’ll use a 50k-row sample of anonymized product-content for initial validation.
- Success criteria: 1) 3x reduction in average model latency vs current solution, 2) precision above 87% on our shared eval set.

Immediate next steps (recommended):
1) I’ve provisioned a 14-day trial on Redwood Dedicated (lite profile) tied to your account — you should have an invite in your inbox from support@redwood.ai.
2) Please upload the anonymized sample CSV to the shared Drive link I sent during the call. If procurement needs anything first, loop them in and we’ll provide the SOC2 evidence.
3) Marcus (cc) will set up a 30–60 minute onboarding session to walk through the quickstart and verify model selection / batching settings.

If your priority shifts or the timing is different, tell me and we’ll adapt the plan — we can pause the Dedicated capacity and convert to a self-serve trial if that’s preferable.

Attachments: I’m including a one-page quickstart and a short checklist to simplify the first login and dataset mapping.

Looking forward to your preferred time for Marcus to run the onboarding.

Best,
